about: Enamel water pail in the main hand, first and third person alike (Cooking V1 K1a, docs/gameplay/cooking_v1_plan.md 7): carried at the side by the bail, the arm hanging, the pail a little out from the leg and its bail across the way (front to back) as a pail is carried. Pouring is item/water_pail_pour (the item's use action), which starts and ends here.
